subject.title: Add an FxTwitter read transport for public lookups, threads, profiles, and search

question: Should Birdclaw core own an opt-in FxTwitter public-service transport and its privacy, reliability, and compatibility contract?
rationale: The architecture can support another live reader and VISION.md is compatible with the proposed boundaries, but adopting a public third-party endpoint is a lasting product and support commitment that repository inspection cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve scoped core transport
options.body: Support explicit public lookup, thread, profile, timeline, and search reads with canonical persistence and no automatic fallback.

options.title: Defer pending transport policy
options.body: Keep the request open but postpone implementation until the supported `bird` and `xurl` direction is settled.

options.title: Decline third-party core dependency
options.body: Keep Birdclaw limited to local archives and owner-controlled authenticated transports.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped core transport
recommendation.body: Support explicit public lookup, thread, profile, timeline, and search reads with canonical persistence and no automatic fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice changes the project’s supported live-transport and privacy boundary defined in VISION.md.
